# MFA Setup on a New Phone

To set up MFA on a new phone, follow these steps [1]:

1. **Raise a ticket** titled "Reset MFA" so the service desk can clear your old MFA registration [1]
2. **Install the app** - Once the ticket is resolved, install Northwind Authenticator from the App Store or Google Play [1]
3. **Scan the QR code** - Sign in to any work app. When asked, scan the QR code shown on screen with the app [1]
4. **Enter the code** - Enter the six-digit code to finish [1]

**Important:** Store your 8 backup codes in the company password manager when you first register [2].

question: My VPN keeps cutting out at home. What can I try?
expected_answer: Update NorthLink to 5.2+; use a cable or move closer to the router; switch protocol from Auto to TCP (vpn_troubleshooting.md)
bot_answer:
If your VPN connection keeps dropping at home, try these steps:

1. **Check your NorthLink version** – Make sure you're running version 5.2 or later, as older versions drop connections on weak Wi-Fi [1].

2. **Improve your connection** – If you're on Wi-Fi, move closer to your router or connect with a network cable instead [1].

3. **Change the protocol** – Switch the protocol in NorthLink settings from "Auto" to "TCP". This fixes most random disconnects [1].

4. **Remember the 12-hour limit** – The VPN disconnects automatically after 12 hours, so you'll need to reconnect and sign in again [2].

If these steps don't work, open a ticket on the service desk portal and attach the NorthLink log file (Help > Export logs) [3].
